# Haritt Developers

> Haritt Developers is a digital solutions company and part of Haritt Group (India). We build websites, web apps and dashboards, mobile apps, e-commerce stores, AI and automation, and brand identities, after first understanding what is actually holding a business back. Contact: developers@haritt.com

The name is spelled Haritt, with two Ts. People sometimes type Harit Developers; it is the same company. Founders: Harsh Goyal and Pulkit Soni.

- [Haritt Developers](https://developers.haritt.com/): Haritt Developers builds websites, web apps, mobile apps, e-commerce, AI and automation for businesses in India, after understanding what is actually holding the business back.
- [What we build](https://developers.haritt.com/services/): Websites, web apps and dashboards, mobile apps, e-commerce, AI and automation, and brand identity, built around how your business works.
- [Websites](https://developers.haritt.com/services/websites/): Business sites and landing pages that explain what you do and turn visitors into calls, bookings or orders. Planned around your business by Haritt Developers.
- [Web apps & dashboards](https://developers.haritt.com/services/web-apps/): Software in the browser for running the business: enquiries, orders, staff, customers and reports. Planned around your business by Haritt Developers.
- [Mobile apps](https://developers.haritt.com/services/mobile-apps/): Android and iPhone apps your customers or team use every day. Planned around your business by Haritt Developers.
- [E-commerce](https://developers.haritt.com/services/e-commerce/): Online stores and catalogues people can browse and pay on, with orders handled behind the scenes. Planned around your business by Haritt Developers.
- [AI & automation](https://developers.haritt.com/services/ai-automation/): Repetitive work done automatically, and AI added only where it saves real time or money. Planned around your business by Haritt Developers.
- [Brand & digital identity](https://developers.haritt.com/services/brand-identity/): A logo, colours and type that look consistent everywhere your business appears. Planned around your business by Haritt Developers.
- [How we work](https://developers.haritt.com/how-we-work/): How a Haritt Developers project runs: understand, discover, strategise, create and improve, and how pricing is worked out.
- [Work](https://developers.haritt.com/work/): Case studies of products Haritt Developers has designed and built: HV Reset, HV Verse and the Haritt Group identity and website. Client work is shown only with permission.
- [HV Reset case study](https://developers.haritt.com/work/hv-reset/): How Haritt Developers designed and built HV Reset, a day planner for web and Android that records what you actually did: problem, decisions, product, architecture, launch and effort.
- [HV Verse case study](https://developers.haritt.com/work/hv-verse/): How Haritt Developers named, designed and built HV Verse: three free apps and one AI under one sign-in, from idea and audience to identity, architecture and launch.
- [Haritt Group case study](https://developers.haritt.com/work/haritt-group/): How Haritt Developers designed the Haritt flame mark, the colour system for its brands, and the haritt.com scroll-film website.
- [About](https://developers.haritt.com/about/): Haritt Developers is the digital solutions company of Haritt Group, India. Our story, what we believe and how we work.
- [Start a conversation](https://developers.haritt.com/first-look/): Tell Haritt Developers about your business or project. No phone number needed. We reply with questions or first thoughts.
- [FAQ](https://developers.haritt.com/faq/): Answers to common questions about working with Haritt Developers: cost, timelines, payments, revisions, ownership and support.
- [Privacy](https://developers.haritt.com/privacy/): How Haritt Developers handles the details you share in an enquiry.
- Parent company: [Haritt Group](https://haritt.com/)
